caption: air-fueled hoverboard racing - sonic team's answer to mario kart, drift-charged and gravity-defying.
about: Sonic riders (2006) is sonic team's hoverboard racer: air is the fuel, drifts and tricks refill it, and the type triangle - speed, fly, power - assigns the best route per character. Gravity-control flips the track's shortcuts open mid-race, and the babylon rogues' story gives the whole thing an attitude the genre still quotes. The windows port carried the whole game to pc with the same gear pool.
The pc build is off sale everywhere, so the archive route keeps the air flowing.
